crossRefs.note: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of…

translations.web: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
translations.bsb: he shall calculate the years since its sale, repay the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his property.
translations.kjv: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
translations.asv: then let him reckon the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return unto his possession.
